verses.original: וְאַתָּה֙ שָׂ֣א קִינָ֔ה אֶל־ נְשִׂיאֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.literal: As for you take up a lament for the princes of Israel
verses.literalPt: Demais, faze uma lamentação sobre os príncipes de Israel

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֗ מָ֤ה אִמְּךָ֙ לְבִיָּ֔א בֵּ֥ין אֲרָי֖וֹת רָבָ֑צָה בְּת֥וֹךְ כְּפִרִ֖ים רִבְּתָ֥ה גוּרֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā māh ’im·mə·ḵā lə·ḇî·yā bên ’ă·rā·yō·wṯ rā·ḇā·ṣāh bə·ṯō·wḵ kə·p̄i·rîm rib·bə·ṯāh ḡū·re·hā
verses.literal: and say What was your mother A lioness among the lions She lay down among the young lions she reared her cubs
verses.literalPt: e dize: Que de leoa era tua mãe entre os leões! No meio dos leões novos deitou-se e nutriu os seus cachorrinhos.

verses.original: וַתַּ֛עַל אֶחָ֥ד מִגֻּרֶ֖יהָ כְּפִ֣יר הָיָ֑ה וַיִּלְמַ֥ד לִטְרָף־ טֶ֖רֶף אָדָ֥ם אָכָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wat·ta·‘al ’e·ḥāḏ mig·gu·re·hā kə·p̄îr hā·yāh way·yil·maḏ liṭ·rāp̄- ṭe·rep̄ ’ā·ḏām ’ā·ḵāl
verses.literal: She brought up one of her cubs and he became a young lion After learning to tear his prey he devoured men
verses.literalPt: Criou um dos seus cachorrinhos, que, fazendo-se leão novo, aprendeu a apanhar presa e devorava homens.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמְע֥וּ אֵלָ֛יו גּוֹיִ֖ם בְּשַׁחְתָּ֣ם נִתְפָּ֑שׂ וַיְבִאֻ֥הוּ בַֽחַחִ֖ים אֶל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·mə·‘ū ’ê·lāw gō·w·yim bə·šaḥ·tām niṯ·pāś way·ḇi·’u·hū ḇa·ḥa·ḥîm ’el- ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: When the nations heard of him he was trapped in their pit With hooks they led him away to the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: Também as nações ouviram falar dele; foi apanhado na cova que elas fizeram, e levaram-no com argolas à terra do Egito.

verses.original: וַתֵּ֙רֶא֙ כִּ֣י נֽוֹחֲלָ֔ה אָבְדָ֖ה תִּקְוָתָ֑הּ וַתִּקַּ֛ח אֶחָ֥ד מִגֻּרֶ֖יהָ כְּפִ֥יר שָׂמָֽתְהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·re kî nō·w·ḥă·lāh ’ā·ḇə·ḏāh tiq·wā·ṯāh wat·tiq·qaḥ ’e·ḥāḏ mig·gu·re·hā kə·p̄îr śā·mā·ṯə·hū
verses.literal: When she saw that she had waited in vain that her hope was lost she took another of her cubs and made him a young lion
verses.literalPt: Ora, a leoa, vendo que já tinha esperado demais, e perdida toda a esperança, pegou em outro dos seus cachorrinhos e fê-lo leão novo.

verses.original: וַיִּתְהַלֵּ֥ךְ בְּתוֹךְ־ אֲרָי֖וֹת כְּפִ֣יר הָיָ֑ה וַיִּלְמַ֥ד לִטְרָף־ טֶ֖רֶף אָדָ֥ם אָכָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·hal·lêḵ bə·ṯō·wḵ- ’ă·rā·yō·wṯ kə·p̄îr hā·yāh way·yil·maḏ liṭ·rāp̄- ṭe·rep̄ ’ā·ḏām ’ā·ḵāl
verses.literal: He prowled among the lions and became a young lion After learning to tear his prey he devoured men
verses.literalPt: Ele andava entre os leões e fez-se leão novo; aprendeu a apanhar presa e devorava homens.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֙דַע֙ אַלְמְנוֹתָ֔יו וְעָרֵיהֶ֖ם הֶחֱרִ֑יב וַתֵּ֤שַׁם אֶ֙רֶץ֙ וּמְלֹאָ֔הּ מִקּ֖וֹל שַׁאֲגָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ḏa‘ ’al·mə·nō·w·ṯāw wə·‘ā·rê·hem he·ḥĕ·rîḇ wat·tê·šam ’e·reṣ ū·mə·lō·’āh miq·qō·wl ša·’ă·ḡā·ṯōw
verses.literal: He broke down their strongholds and devastated their cities The land and everything in it shuddered at the sound of his roaring
verses.literalPt: Conheceu os palácios deles e devastou as suas cidades; ficou desolada a terra e a sua plenitude, por causa do som do seu rugir.

verses.original: וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ עָלָ֥יו גּוֹיִ֛ם סָבִ֖יב מִמְּדִינ֑וֹת וַֽיִּפְרְשׂ֥וּ עָלָ֛יו רִשְׁתָּ֖ם בְּשַׁחְתָּ֥ם נִתְפָּֽשׂ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tə·nū ‘ā·lāw gō·w·yim sā·ḇîḇ mim·mə·ḏî·nō·wṯ way·yip̄·rə·śū ‘ā·lāw riš·tām bə·šaḥ·tām niṯ·pāś
verses.literal: Then the nations set out against him from the provinces on every side They spread their net over him he was trapped in their pit
verses.literalPt: Então, se ajuntaram contra ele as nações vindas das províncias de todos os lados; e estenderam sobre ele a sua rede; e ele foi apanhado na cova que elas fizeram.

verses.original: וַֽיִּתְּנֻ֤הוּ בַסּוּגַר֙ בַּֽחַחִ֔ים וַיְבִאֻ֖הוּ אֶל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֑ל יְבִאֻ֙הוּ֙ בַּמְּצֹד֔וֹת לְמַ֗עַן לֹא־ יִשָּׁמַ֥ע קוֹל֛וֹ ע֖וֹד אֶל־ הָרֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tə·nu·hū ḇas·sū·ḡar ba·ḥa·ḥîm way·ḇi·’u·hū ’el- me·leḵ bā·ḇel yə·ḇi·’u·hū bam·mə·ṣō·ḏō·wṯ lə·ma·‘an lō- yiš·šā·ma‘ qō·w·lōw ‘ō·wḏ ’el- hā·rê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: With hooks they caged him . . . and brought him to the king of Babylon They brought him into captivity so that his roar was heard no longer on the mountains of Israel
verses.literalPt: Com argolas, meteram-no numa gaiola e levaram-no ao rei de Babilônia; fizeram-no entrar em lugares fortes, para que não se ouvisse mais a sua voz sobre os montes de Israel.

verses.original: אִמְּךָ֥ כַגֶּ֛פֶן בְּדָמְךָ֖ עַל־ מַ֣יִם שְׁתוּלָ֑ה פֹּֽרִיָּה֙ וַֽעֲנֵפָ֔ה הָיְתָ֖ה מִמַּ֥יִם רַבִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’im·mə·ḵā ḵag·ge·p̄en bə·ḏā·mə·ḵā ‘al- ma·yim šə·ṯū·lāh pō·rî·yāh wa·‘ă·nê·p̄āh hā·yə·ṯāh mim·ma·yim rab·bîm
verses.literal: Your mother was like a vine in your vineyard planted by the water it was fruitful and full of branches because of the abundant waters
verses.literalPt: Tua mãe, à tua semelhança, era como uma vide plantada junto às águas; era frutífera e cheia de sarmentos por causa das muitas águas.

verses.original: וַיִּֽהְיוּ־ לָ֞הּ מַטּ֣וֹת עֹ֗ז אֶל־ שִׁבְטֵי֙ מֹֽשְׁלִ֔ים וַתִּגְבַּ֥הּ קֽוֹמָת֖וֹ עַל־ בֵּ֣ין עֲבֹתִ֑ים וַיֵּרָ֣א בְגָבְה֔וֹ בְּרֹ֖ב דָּלִיֹּתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yih·yū- lāh maṭ·ṭō·wṯ ‘ōz ’el- šiḇ·ṭê mō·šə·lîm wat·tiḡ·bah qō·w·mā·ṯōw ‘al- bên ‘ă·ḇō·ṯîm way·yê·rā ḇə·ḡā·ḇə·hōw bə·rōḇ dā·lî·yō·ṯāw
verses.literal: It had strong branches fit for a ruler’s scepter It towered high above . . . the thick branches conspicuous for its height and for its dense foliage
verses.literalPt: Tinha ela varas fortes para os cetros dos que dominavam, foi exaltada a sua estatura entre os espessos ramos e foi vista na sua altura com a multidão dos seus ramos.

verses.original: וַתֻּתַּ֤שׁ בְּחֵמָה֙ לָאָ֣רֶץ הֻשְׁלָ֔כָה וְר֥וּחַ הַקָּדִ֖ים הוֹבִ֣ישׁ פִּרְיָ֑הּ הִתְפָּרְק֧וּ וְיָבֵ֛שׁוּ מַטֵּ֥ה עֻזָּ֖הּ אֵ֥שׁ אֲכָלָֽתְהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tut·taš bə·ḥê·māh lā·’ā·reṣ huš·lā·ḵāh wə·rū·aḥ haq·qā·ḏîm hō·w·ḇîš pir·yāh hiṯ·pā·rə·qū wə·yā·ḇê·šū maṭ·ṭêh ‘uz·zāh ’êš ’ă·ḵā·lā·ṯə·hū
verses.literal: But it was uprooted in fury cast down to the ground and the east wind dried up its fruit Its strong branches were stripped off and they withered the fire consumed them
verses.literalPt: Porém, em furor, foi ela arrancada e lançada por terra, e o vento oriental secou ao seu fruto. Foram quebradas e secaram as suas fortes varas; o fogo as consumiu.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֖ה שְׁתוּלָ֣ה בַמִּדְבָּ֑ר בְּאֶ֖רֶץ צִיָּ֥ה וְצָמָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh šə·ṯū·lāh ḇam·miḏ·bār bə·’e·reṣ ṣî·yāh wə·ṣā·mā
verses.literal: Now it is planted in the wilderness in a dry and thirsty land
verses.literalPt: Agora está plantada num deserto, numa terra árida e sedenta.

verses.original: וַתֵּצֵ֨א אֵ֜שׁ מִמַּטֵּ֤ה בַדֶּ֙יהָ֙ פִּרְיָ֣הּ אָכָ֔לָה וְלֹא־ הָ֥יָה בָ֛הּ מַטֵּה־ עֹ֖ז שֵׁ֣בֶט לִמְשׁ֑וֹל קִ֥ינָה הִ֖יא וַתְּהִ֥י לְקִינָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·ṣê ’êš mim·maṭ·ṭêh ḇad·de·hā pir·yāh ’ā·ḵā·lāh wə·lō- hā·yāh ḇāh maṭ·ṭêh- ‘ōz šê·ḇeṭ lim·šō·wl qî·nāh hî wat·tə·hî lə·qî·nāh
verses.literal: Fire has gone out from its main branch . . . and devoured its fruit on it no strong branch remains fit for a ruler’s scepter This is a lament and shall be used as a lament
verses.literalPt: Das varas dos seus ramos saiu um fogo que consumiu ao seu fruto de maneira que não há mais nela vara forte que sirva de cetro para dominar. Isso é para lamentar e servirá de lamentação.
